mapper.sql: select member_id, name, phone, password, region, referrer_id, direct_index, level, vip_expire_at, balance_cents, green_points, upgraded_at, create_time, del_flag from hys_member
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') and level = #{level} order by member_id desc
where referrer_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0' order by direct_index asc
select count(*) from hys_member where referrer_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'

with recursive sub as ( select member_id from hys_member where referrer_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0' union all select m.member_id from hys_member m join sub s on m.referrer_id = s.member_id where m.del_flag = '0' ) select count(*) from sub
select direct_index from hys_member where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: insert into hys_member (name, phone, password, region, referrer_id, direct_index, level, vip_expire_at, balance_cents, green_points, upgraded_at, create_time, del_flag) values (#{name}, #{phone}, #{password}, #{region}, #{referrerId}, #{directIndex}, #{level}, #{vipExpireAt}, #{balanceCents}, #{greenPoints}, #{upgradedAt}, #{createTime}, '0')
mapper.update: update hys_member set balance_cents = balance_cents - #{cents} where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0' and balance_cents >= #{cents}
update hys_member set balance_cents = balance_cents + #{cents} where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = '0'
